- Score: R@5 = 0.71 on the stratified slice, versus 0.93 for whole-session blobs.
- Rejection reason: fixed windows cut across session boundaries, while those boundaries carried most of the retrieval signal.
- As a result, the fixed-window implementation was never merged.
